tools.name: lookup_number
tools.description: Find every IcePartsDB page a commercial ice machine part or model number could mean (any case, with or without dashes; aliases too), plus entries from the makers' own parts lists and model series eBay sellers name. Use first when the user gives a number.

tools.name: get_part
tools.description: Facts for one commercial ice machine part: what it is, live eBay price range with "as of" time, the makers' parts lists that print it, the models and series eBay sellers list it for (claims, not verified fitment), other numbers sellers use, and the cheapest listings (affiliate links).

tools.name: get_machine
tools.description: Facts for one commercial ice machine model: DOE / ENERGY STAR ratings (harvest rate, energy, water), estimated running cost per year, the maker's documents and parts list where available, parts eBay sellers list for the model or its series (claims), recalls and similar machines.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search IcePartsDB by part or model number; a brand name may come first ("hoshizaki 2A1410-02"). Returns exact matches, similar numbers, seller-named series and makers' parts-list entries. Descriptions such as "water pump" are not searched: use the guides listed in llms.txt.

tools.name: serial_number_age
tools.description: Date of manufacture and age from the serial number, using only the makers' own published date rules (Scotsman, Manitowoc incl. the MFG DT code, Ice-O-Matic). Hoshizaki serials are not decoded.

tools.name: running_cost
tools.description: Electricity and water cost per year (and over a machine's life) for up to three ice machine models, from their DOE / ENERGY STAR ratings and DOE's duty cycle. Same method and numbers as the running-cost tool page.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
